verdict.rationale: Token2 ships developer-facing tooling: a libfido2-based CLI and Graph API enrollment scripts, so a published API reference is a fair question. However, the evidence shows no interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The in-browser FIDO2 and TOTP demo pages are product demos of the WebAuthn and TOTP standards, not an explorable reference for a Token2 API.
